description: Configure automated 24/7 RSS, Atom, or XML Sitemap polling for an app_id, or trigger an immediate feed check and push broadcast via dispatch_now=true. Use this tool when a blog, news portal, or store wants newly published URLs automatically broadcast as push notifications; do not use it for manual one-off messages (use send_push_notification instead) or fixed-time calendar campaigns (use schedule_push_notification instead). Prerequisite: call list_apps first to obtain app_id. Requires PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY; feed URLs are validated against SSRF rules, deduplicated by item GUID/URL so each post is sent only once, and deduct 1 credit per delivered subscriber when a new item is broadcast (setting dispatch_now=true immediately fetches and broadcasts the newest feed entry even if rss_enabled=false). Returns JSON { ok, app_id, rss_enabled, rss_feed_url, rss_interval, dispatched_now, latest_item_title }.

app_id.description: Target application ID in format app_xxxx (obtain from list_apps)

dispatch_now.description: Set true to immediately fetch the latest feed entry and broadcast it to active subscribers right now

rss_enabled.description: Set true to enable background RSS/Sitemap polling at rss_interval, or false to pause background polling

rss_feed_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the RSS 2.0, Atom, or XML Sitemap feed (required when enabling polling or calling dispatch_now=true)

rss_prefix.description: Optional text prepended to each auto-generated notification title (e.g., 'Artikel Baru: ')

name: configure_rss_autopush
